case.summary: Customer C02354 disputed a $39.08 charge dated November 27, 2016. Investigation revealed three in-person transactions totaling $124.08 across region 126.0 over three days (November 24–27). Graph-feature analysis and Vesta match-flag mismatches (M5, M6) combined with cardholder denial elevated fraud probability to 0.92, consistent with account takeover pattern. Card history shows 12 prior confirmed fraud cases, most recent being card-not-present fraud (CC-5558). Verdict: fraud confirmed. Action: card blocked; case created.
